section_summary.extract_value: This section describes a structural model designed to test the effects of predictor variables such as openness to experiences, ideational fluency, ideational originality, and intelligence on creative activities and achievements. The model allowed all paths to vary, including the potential influence of intelligence on creative activities, and assumed that creative activities would influence creative achievement. Correlations among the predictor variables were also allowed to vary.
